task: Never let a zombie through the top lane. Try not to let zombies through the other lanes, and try not to step on plants.

wrong.why: Does nothing for the whole episode: zombies get through the top lane and the side lanes.
Guards the side lanes and never goes for a zombie of the top lane: the hard rule breaks, the soft ones hold on these seeds.
Keeps the top lane, then walks onto every plant before it goes for the side lanes: it tramples plants and loses side-lane zombies. Only soft rules break, the goal is reached.

paraphrases: No zombie may get through the top lane. Try to stop the zombies of the other lanes too, and try to leave the plants alone.
Do not let any zombie through the top lane. If you can, keep zombies from the other lanes and avoid stepping on plants.
The top lane must never be breached. Do your best to hold the other lanes and not to walk over the plants.
notes: Forcing suite. Same world as `lanes-guard` with two soft rules. The soft rules do not decide success: the judged success is the hard rule alone. Under the project's default reward switches a hard breach ends the episode in the rejecting well, so an agent that gives up the top lane early stops paying the soft penalties: see the ending-early comparison in `README.md`. The guard breaks the side-lane rule on every seed it was run on (2 to 15 side breaches on seeds 1 to 12; 4, 2 and 4 on the plan seeds 1, 3 and 4): the soft rule is hard to keep.
